visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with dark hair and a beige tank top is seated on the floor of a living room, intensely focused on eating a fried chicken drumstick. She is positioned in front of a coffee table that holds a pizza box featuring a black 'Batman' promotional insert, various pieces of fried chicken, and a smartphone resting face-down. (2) A man's hand enters the frame from the bottom left, reaching toward the smartphone. The woman's eyes immediately widen as she notices the movement; she abruptly stops chewing and drops her drumstick to quickly grab a much larger piece of fried chicken from the box, thrusting it toward the camera as a defensive distraction. (3) She maintains a wide-eyed, slightly frantic facial expression while holding the large chicken piece close to the lens, effectively blocking the view of the phone. She nods slightly, her mouth still partially full, emphasizing the offer of food to the person off-camera. (4) After the hand retreats, she slowly lowers the large chicken piece back into the box. She picks up her original drumstick and resumes eating, casting a brief, wary glance toward the camera before looking back down at her meal, maintaining a slightly guarded posture.
